messages:
Iris Chen: Quick QA pass on the component library — spotted a few issues: compact table rows look cramped with current small-button padding, primary button focus ring disappears on the dark header, and transient toasts vanish too quickly for assistive tech users. Can we scope a small iteration? :mag:
Samir Patel: Thanks Iris. I started a WIP branch to experiment with spacing tokens and focus styles. Will push a diff after a couple tweaks.
Samir Patel: Token sketch in the branch:
```css
:root {
  --spacing-compact: 8px; /* new: denser layouts */
  --row-height-compact: 32px;
  --btn-padding-compact: 6px 12px;
  --focus-ring-size: 3px;
  --color-primary-dark: #0f2b66;
}
```
Marta Ruiz: Accessibility checklist: 1) Confirm focus ring contrast against dark header (needs >=4.5:1 for text on focus). 2) Make toasts default duration longer (6s) or provide a persistent option. 3) Add `aria-live="polite"` and ensure keyboard-triggered toasts are reachable.
DesignBot: accessibility-scan: `button--primary` contrast ratio currently 3.9:1 — recommend darker primary or bolder label.
Leo Grant: For the routes table, reducing horizontal padding from 16px to 12px saves width. Adding `row-height-compact` token will help vertical density. Also watch badge wrapping at narrow widths.
Iris Chen: Agreed on tokens. I'll update Figma components: spacing-compact=8px, row-height-compact=32px, btn-padding-compact=6px 12px. For focus ring: prefer a 3px box-shadow using a color token with outline fallback. Will annotate the spec and attach screenshots.
Samir Patel: I'll update CSS vars, add browser fallbacks, and expose toast API option: `toast({ message, durationMs?: number | 'persistent' })`. Setting default to 6000ms unless overridden.
Marta Ruiz: UX/copy nit: confirm vs save — let's standardize. Use "Confirm" for destructive actions with clear consequence copy; use "Save" for non-destructive state changes. Also ensure dialog focus order sets close button as first focusable for keyboard users.
Iris Chen: Good call. I'll normalize labels in the spec and add an A11y checklist (focus order, aria-modal, role=dialog, label states). Will loop Claire in for copy review.
Samir Patel: PR updated: switched primary to #0f2b66, bump focus ring to 3px, added compact spacing tokens, default toast 6000ms. CI shows one visual diff on hover state of primary button — asking design to confirm hover color.
Iris Chen: For hover, use primary-500 -> primary-600 (slightly darker). I'll drop a Figma swatch and hex values here.
Leo Grant: Note: compact spacing affects truncation patterns. I'll run layout tests with long job names and many badges after merge.
Marta Ruiz: Once merged to staging, can we run axe scan and a keyboard-only pass? Tag me for the run.
Samir Patel: Will open a staging PR and tag @Marta for axe.
Iris Chen: Thanks team — I'll post updated spec images and token table here when ready. :thumbsup:
